description: This file defines a final class 'CanvasFileWatcher' that conforms to 'Sendable' and 'SimpleFileWatcherOwner'. It encapsulates a file watcher using 'SimpleFileWatcher' and 'CoalescingFSEventsWatcher' to monitor changes at a specified URL path. The class initializes the watcher with provided URL and change handler.

classes.name: CanvasFileWatcher
classes.description: A class that manages a file watcher for a specific directory or file, triggering a callback on changes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the CanvasFileWatcher with a URL and a callback to invoke upon changes.
